User Profile & Preferences (Consolidated Jul 15–Jul 28, 2026):
* 🔴 User stated they prefer outdoor running over treadmills, have a torn meniscus in the left knee, sleep exactly 7 hours nightly, and work as a graphic designer downtown (WFH Thursdays and Fridays).
* 🔴 User stated they have been a vegetarian for over 4 years and take a magnesium supplement every evening before bed.
* 🔴 User stated specific rules: no headphones on busy streets, no bouncing waist packs, and no neon-colored apparel on early morning road runs.
* 🔴 User stated dietary preferences: black coffee pre-long run, coconut water / lemon-infused coconut water post-long run, whole-wheat pasta the night before hard workouts, and steel-cut oats with blueberries on high-mileage mornings.
* 🔴 User stated their half marathon is September 4, 2026.
* 🟢 User gear & lifestyle: Garmin Forerunner 265, Nike Pegasus shoes, Merino wool socks, indie rock playlist, and a pet golden retriever that joins evening walks.
